tool.name: list_md_objects
tool.description: List MdObjects in a project, optionally filtered by kind

tool.name: get_md_object
tool.description: Get details of a single MdObject by FQN

tool.name: create_md_object
tool.description: Create a new top-level MdObject in a project

tool.name: rename_md_object
tool.description: Rename a top-level MdObject (BM-only, α)

tool.name: set_md_property
tool.description: Set a property on an MdObject or its attribute

tool.name: list_attributes
tool.description: List attributes/dimensions/resources of an MdObject

tool.name: add_attribute
tool.description: Add an attribute/dimension/resource to an MdObject

tool.name: rename_attribute
tool.description: Rename an attribute/dimension/resource of an MdObject

tool.name: borrow_md_object
tool.description: Adopt (borrow) an MdObject from base configuration into an extension. project = extension name; fqn = '<Kind>.<Name>' of base object.

tool.name: borrow_form
tool.description: Sub-borrow a Form from base parent MdObject into extension. parentFqn = already-borrowed parent in extension.

tool.name: add_tabular_section
tool.description: Add a TabularSection to a parent MdObject (Catalog/Document/BusinessProcess/Task/ChartOfX). Columns are added via add_tabular_section_attribute.

tool.name: add_tabular_section_attribute
tool.description: Add a column (attribute) to an existing TabularSection. tsFqn = 'Kind.Owner.TabularSection.Name'.

tool.name: add_extension_method_override
tool.description: Append a BSL procedure (with &ИзменениеИКонтроль/&Перед/&После/&Вместо annotation) to an extension module. Creates file + parent folders if missing.

tool.name: add_register_recorder
tool.description: Link a Document as a recorder of an AccumulationRegister/AccountingRegister/CalculationRegister/InformationRegister. Writes both <recorders> on register and <registerRecords> on document; idempotent.

tool.name: add_subsystem_content
tool.description: Add an MdObject reference to a Subsystem's content list (command-interface binding); idempotent.

tool.name: set_constant_type
tool.description: Set the value type of a Constant. type=string or array (composite). Supported: String(N), Number(P,S), Date, Boolean, CatalogRef.X, DocumentRef.Y, EnumRef.Z, AnyRef, UUID.

tool.name: set_md_type
tool.description: Set the type of an Attribute/Dimension/Resource on an MdObject via DOM (replace-or-add). fqn forms: 'Catalog.X.Attribute.Y', 'Document.X.TabularSection.TS.Y', 'InformationRegister.X.Dimension.Y', 'Constant.X' (fallback). Same type-expressions as set_constant_type.

tool.name: create_data_composition_schema
tool.description: Stage 8f MVP: create a minimal .dcs skeleton in an existing Report (Templates/<Name>/Template.dcs) and register it in Report .mdo (mainDataCompositionSchema + templates). Skeleton has one empty DataSetObject and a Основной settingsVariant with auto-selection; further editing is file-level or via EDT GUI. Idempotent.

tool.name: borrow_form_pictures
tool.description: Stage 10: auto-discover CommonPicture refs in an adopted Form's Form.form and borrow each missing CommonPicture (skeleton .mdo + <commonPictures> entry in extension Configuration.mdo). parentFqn = 'CommonForm.X' or 'Kind.Owner.Form.Y'. Idempotent.

tool.name: add_dcs_data_set_query
tool.description: Stage 8f: append a <dataSet xsi:type="DataSetQuery"> to an existing Template.dcs. Args: reportFqn='Report.X', templateName (default 'ОсновнаяСхема'), dataSetName, query (text of 1C query, may be empty), dataSource (default: first <dataSource> in .dcs). Idempotent.

tool.name: add_dcs_field
tool.description: Stage 8f: append a <field xsi:type="DataSetFieldField"> into an existing dataSet inside Template.dcs. Args: reportFqn, templateName?, dataSetName, fieldName, title?. Idempotent on (dataSetName, fieldName).

tool.name: add_dcs_parameter
tool.description: Stage 8f: append a <parameter> to Template.dcs. Args: reportFqn, templateName?, parameterName, valueType (XSD/v8 type, optional), title (optional). Idempotent on parameterName.

tool.name: add_dcs_calculated_field
tool.description: Stage 8f: append a <calculatedField> to Template.dcs root. Args: reportFqn, templateName?, dataPath, expression (1C calc formula), title (optional). Idempotent on dataPath.

tool.name: add_dcs_total_field
tool.description: Stage 8f: append a <totalField> (aggregation) to Template.dcs root. Args: reportFqn, templateName?, dataPath, expression (e.g. 'Сумма(X)'), groupKeys (array). Idempotent on dataPath.

tool.name: add_dcs_dataset_link
tool.description: Stage 8f: append a <dataSetLink> (master-detail) between two DataSets in Template.dcs. Args: reportFqn, templateName?, source, destination, sourceExpression, destinationExpression, parameter (optional). Both DataSets must already exist. Idempotent on (source,dest,srcExpr,destExpr).

tool.name: set_dcs_query_text
tool.description: Stage 8f: replace the <query> text on an existing <dataSet xsi:type="DataSetQuery"> in Template.dcs. Args: reportFqn, templateName?, dataSetName, query. Throws if dataSet not found or not DataSetQuery.

tool.name: add_dcs_setting_grouping
tool.description: Stage 8g: append a GroupItemField (grouping by a field) to the root StructureItemGroup of a settingsVariant in Template.dcs. Args: reportFqn, templateName?, variantName? (default 'Основной'), field, groupType? (Items|Hierarchy|HierarchyOnly, default Items). Idempotent on (variantName, field).

tool.name: add_dcs_setting_filter
tool.description: Stage 8g: append a FilterItemComparison to a settingsVariant of Template.dcs. Args: reportFqn, templateName?, variantName? (default 'Основной'), leftField, comparisonType (Equal|NotEqual|Greater|Less|Contains|...), use? (boolean, default false). Idempotent on (leftField, comparisonType).

tool.name: set_dcs_setting_parameter_value
tool.description: Stage 8g: set (or add) a SettingsParameterValue in a settingsVariant of Template.dcs. Args: reportFqn, templateName?, variantName? (default 'Основной'), parameterName, value? (omitted ⇒ xsi:nil). Replace-or-add.
